views.name: CarouselView
views.description: Displays a scrollable list of data items in a carousel layout

views.name: CollectionView
views.description: Displays a scrollable list of selectable data items using different layout specifications

views.name: ContentView
views.description: A control that contains a single child element

views.name: Frame
views.description: A layout that wraps a view or layout with a border and shadow (Obsolete: use Border instead)

views.name: ListView
views.description: Displays a scrollable list of selectable data items

views.name: ScrollView
views.description: Provides a scrolling container for content that exceeds the visible area

views.name: SwipeView
views.description: Wraps an item and provides context menu items revealed by a swipe gesture

views.name: TableView
views.description: Displays a table of scrollable items organized into sections

layouts.name: AbsoluteLayout
layouts.description: Positions child elements at specific locations relative to the layout

layouts.name: BindableLayout
layouts.description: Enables any layout class that derives from Layout to generate its content by binding to a collection of items

layouts.name: FlexLayout
layouts.description: Arranges child elements in rows or columns with flexible sizing options

layouts.name: Grid
layouts.description: Arranges child elements in rows and columns

layouts.name: HorizontalStackLayout
layouts.description: Arranges child elements horizontally in a single line

layouts.name: StackLayout
layouts.description: Arranges child elements vertically or horizontally in a stack

layouts.name: VerticalStackLayout
layouts.description: Arranges child elements vertically in a single line

cells.name: EntryCell
cells.description: Combines a label with an entry control, typically used in TableView

cells.name: ImageCell
cells.description: Displays an image with text and detail text, typically used in ListView

cells.name: SwitchCell

cells.description: Displays text and detail text, typically used in ListView or TableView

cells.name: ViewCell
cells.description: Displays a custom view, typically used in ListView or TableView
